beats.care: Hostel mess fees, tiffin prices and your family's grocery bill can all rise. Ration card holders are better protected by the state's stock.
beats.what: Rice inflation in Telangana rose from 4% in April to 13% in September, and retail Sona rice now costs ₹85 to ₹90 a kilo.
beats.why: A weak, El Niño-hit monsoon left a 23% rain shortfall, and the state urged farmers to grow less water-hungry crops than paddy.

cards.body: Minister Uttam Kumar Reddy told officials on 19 October to build a buffer for 3.42 crore ration users. The state says it has enough grain for about 11.7 months.
Paddy has a ready system of buyers and mills. Vegetables and pulses have weaker supply chains, so farmers fear they won't sell. Horticulture land still grew from 2.25 to 3.54 lakh acres.
cards.title: why don't farmers just switch crops?

cards.body: Farm leader T Sagar says middle-class families will be hit hardest, because the poorest get rice through ration shops.

cards.q: Has rice gone up at your home?
Why is rice getting costlier in Telangana?
cards.why: A poor El Niño monsoon and less paddy planting cut supply, so prices rose.

hook: Rice inflation in Telangana jumped from 4% to *13%*. What's driving it?

learn.t: Wholesale Sona rice rose about 65% in a year, from ₹2,068 to ₹3,419 per quintal, which is 100 kg.

sources.title: Middle class pockets take hit as rice prices surge in Telangana

tldr: Rice in Telangana has become much costlier this year, and farmers' groups warn prices may not fall soon.
watch: Telangana is considering adding wheat flour to ration shops. Watch for a decision, and for new harvest prices in the coming months.
